text: RACE DAY: Runners compete Sunday during the 2026 Chicago Marathon, with more than 55,000 entrants registered. Amos Kipruto of Kenya finished first, with a time of 2:01:09, while Ethiopia's Hawi Feysa defended her women's title in 2:13:33.
